_comment: Authored (not LLM-recorded) PySub rewrites for the offline demo. Keyed by function name; scripts/author_offline_cache.py turns each attempt into demo/offline_cache/llm/<key>.json. Re-record with scripts/record_offline_cache.sh once an API key is available.

knn_vote.note: comprehension/generator/zip/sorted/tuple loops -> explicit loops + k-pass selection; first attempt keeps a generator expression inside sum(), so the retry loop shows

life_generations.note: tuple loops, ternary, enumerate, [row[:]...], [0]*w, sum() -> range loops + explicit appends (ragged rows and gens=0 behave like the original)

collatz_longest.note: annotations only (derived from the trace's observed types, so the fixer is never asked)
